description_json.name: Rot13WithSpaceToDash
description_json.idea: Apply standard ROT13 to all alphabetic characters (preserving case) to leverage the model's native understanding of ROT13. To disrupt token-based sentence structure detection while keeping the reasoning overhead extremely low, replace all spaces with dashes '-' and all dashes with spaces ' '. Digits and punctuation remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. For each character in the plaintext:
   a. If it is an alphabetic character, apply standard ROT13 (shift by 13 modulo 26, preserving case).
   b. If it is a space ' ', replace it with a dash '-'.
   c. If it is a dash '-', replace it with a space ' '.
   d. If it is any other character (digit, punctuation, etc.), leave it unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
1. For each character in the ciphertext:
   a. If it is an alphabetic character, apply standard ROT13 (shift by 13 modulo 26, preserving case).
   b. If it is a dash '-', replace it with a space ' '.
   c. If it is a space ' ', replace it with a dash '-'.
   d. If it is any other character (digit, punctuation, etc.), leave it unchanged.
